items.name: airframe
items.title: Airframe
items.description: The Airframe design system as the tool repos vendor it: the --af- tokens (Night and Day), the af- component classes and the icon sprite. CSS only; works in any project. Load airframe.css, then airframe-components.css.

items.name: airframe-tailwind
items.title: Airframe for Tailwind CSS v4
items.description: The --af- tokens plus a Tailwind v4 @theme that maps every utility onto them (bg-canvas, text-fg-muted, font-mono, text-label, rounded-card). Removes Tailwind's default color, font, radius and shadow scales so an Airframe project has no bg-blue-500. Import both files after `@import "tailwindcss"`.

items.name: airframe-tokens
items.title: Airframe design tokens (DTCG)
items.description: Every Airframe token in the W3C Design Tokens format (DTCG 2025.10), one complete file per theme, for Figma variables, Style Dictionary, Terrazzo and other token tools. Also the resolved-per-theme JSON the suite's scripts use.

items.name: airframe-docs
items.title: Airframe for a docs site
items.description: The docs-site look for Material for MkDocs or Zensical: airframe-docs.css maps the theme onto the tokens (header with the product mark and hue, home hero, page anatomy, tables, admonitions, code, figures), and airframe-suite.html is the suite strip above the header that links every product's docs site. Needs airframe.css; wire with theme.custom_dir, extra.airframe.product and a two-line overrides/main.html (see the Airframe docs).

items.name: skill
items.title: Airframe skill for coding agents
items.description: A SKILL.md (Agent Skills standard) that keeps Claude Code and Codex on Airframe when they build UI: tokens only, the af- classes, the six statuses, the dark-cockpit rule, and where each component's contract lives. Installs for both agents.

items.name: helpers
items.title: Airframe helpers (airframe.js)
items.description: One ES module, no dependencies, no build step: markup helpers that match the component contracts (status, icon, meta, btn, avatar, obj, tag; everything escaped) and the behaviours: toast (held while a person is mid-decision), confirm (an af-dialog that replaces window.confirm), drawer (Escape, focus return, inert page), expand (a row or card opening in place), deck (the decision deck) and roving (arrow keys over rows and tiles). The CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: DM Mono capitals on a 2px radius: primary (signal yellow, one per view), secondary, ghost and danger, at 34 or 28 px. Installs the component contract (markup, classes, do and don't); the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: status
items.title: Status
items.description: The six statuses, each color + shape + word: running (grey circle), queued (ring), needs approval (orange diamond), failed (red triangle), denied (red placard), off (small dot). Running and queued stay grey: the dark-cockpit rule. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Tonal cards: raised on canvas, 4px radius, 16px padding, no border and no shadow, with top, body and foot parts and a lit state for when a person is needed. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: fleet-bay
items.title: Fleet bays
items.description: The fleet as bays: one box per sandbox grouped by environment, with tail number, status, the work, owner, harness, a labeled stage track, lease left and the one action it needs. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: approval-card
items.title: Approval card
items.description: A held action waiting on a reviewer: the exact command, policy, checks, expiry; inspect, deny with a required reason, approve, approve edited, approve for the session; a quorum strip and the grey waiting-on-others state; verdict rows. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: question
items.title: Question
items.description: An agent asks a person: the question, its context, option chips plus free text (free text dismisses the options), one primary action; the approval role with the word Needs input. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: stage-rail
items.title: Stage rail
items.description: Plan, edit, test, PR as a rail, a ring or a capsule: grey while running, the status color on the head when a person is needed, solid only for a reported pct and dotted for an estimate. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: heartbeat
items.title: Heartbeat
items.description: A recency dot and the time since an agent last did something: it breathes only for a live agent, shows a wait in orange, and is still under reduced motion. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: activity-timeline
items.title: Activity timeline
items.description: An agent's history as a vertical timeline: wall-clock and relative time, the event, stage boundaries in fg, holds and failures marked, the latest dot lit. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: agent-row
items.title: Agent row
items.description: The fleet's List view: one agent per row with mark, tail, work and a live now-line with its heartbeat, owner, harness, stage rail, stage times, sparkline and cost, opening in place into a console. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: agent-card
items.title: Agent card
items.description: The fleet's Board view: a card per agent with avatar, tail, stage ring, work, now-line, capsule and owner, opening in place across the board. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: decision-deck
items.title: Decision deck
items.description: What needs you, one decision at a time: a stacked deck ordered by expiry with n of N, previous, next, skip and an up-next list; inline approve, deny with a required reason, answer with chips, retry and acknowledge; a calm empty state. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: fleet-console
items.title: Fleet console
items.description: The composed Fleet page: a headline in words, the decision deck on top, and the fleet as List or Board over one selection. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: composer
items.title: Composer
items.description: An input with suggestion chips and one send button: a queued row (applies after this tool call) with a take-back, and a disabled state that says why. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: diff
items.title: Diff
items.description: A unified, greyscale diff: file header with the +N −M stat, hunk headers, additions in fg with a gutter bar, deletions in fg-muted, line numbers, per-line comments routed to the agent, and the failed triangle on the hunk a failing test points at. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: The avatar triad: people round, agents hexagonal, firms square; initials in mono on a hairline at 22, 28 or 44 px; stacked groups and the af-who row. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: object-chip
items.title: Object chip
items.description: A business object by reference: source glyph, mono key, title, state word on a surface tile; link, restricted and approval-mark variants; a trust line (source, freshness, provenance) on hover. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page header
items.description: Title in two sizes, a lede, a summary line (status mark, keyed counts, capacity) and an actions slot; stacks when narrow. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: No data, after an action and error, plus a compact variant; the clear state (Nothing is waiting on you) as the hero. One primary action and at most one link; errors get no illustration and no second action. Installs the contract; the CSS comes with the airframe item.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Bottom centre, overlay tone, one optional action, the failed mark for a bad outcome, role=status; lifts above a bottom drawer; held while a person is mid-decision (alert inhibition). Installs the contract; the behaviour is in helpers.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A <dialog> with title, body and a footer in inspect, refuse, accept order; the confirm and danger variants replace window.confirm(). Installs the contract; the behaviour is in helpers.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A right sheet (480 px) and a bottom drawer (40vh) over a scrim, toast above drawer above scrim; Escape, focus return and an inert page with helpers. Installs the contract; the behaviour is in helpers.

items.name: react
items.title: Airframe React wrappers
items.description: Thin React components over the af- classes: Button, Status, Card and Icon. They compose class names only, so they cannot drift from the CSS; the CSS comes with the airframe item. A prototype: the suite's consoles are vanilla JS today.
